Effect: Winded Up.description: The aspect has a key in its back which can be wound up to increase the power of the aspect. The key can be wound with a single Interact action, which reloads its primary attack, and gives it a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed for 1 round.

Aquatic Sense.name: Aquatic Sense
Aquatic Sense.description: The aspect gains your choice of bloodscent as a precise sense with a range of 30 feet or wavesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

Terminus of Bounded Might.name: Terminus of Bounded Might
Terminus of Bounded Might.description:
Trigger After your second draw, you Cast a Spell that would increase your essence.

Requirements You haven’t experienced an essence leak this encounter.

You gather all the essence you’ve built up during the encounter to allow you to cast an even more powerful spell.

Cycle 1 Instead of your essence being reduced to 0 as normal for a bounded essence caster casting an essence spell, your essence increases to 1 above your essence pool. This means that starting the next turn, you can cast an essence spell of up to that rank. When you do, your essence is reduced to 0.

Churning Aura.name: Churning Aura
Churning Aura.description: Water roils around the aspect. The aspect’s Strikes deal bludgeoning damage. All non-magical fires in the area are extinguished and creatures with a swim Speed treat water in the area as if it were difficult terrain, or greater difficult terrain if the creature does not have a swim Speed. The aspect gains the Swimmer aspect ability. The aspect has a resistance to fire and a weakness to electricity and is sourced by water.

Torment.name: Torment
Torment.description:
Requirements The velstrac’s last action was a successful Strike against a creature

When the aspect torments the enemy further, the triggering creature takes @Damage[@actor.flags.pf2e.aspectRank[persistent,bleed]] damage equal to the rank of the spell.

Caster.name: Caster
Caster.description: The aspect can cast 2 spells of your choice from the listed spells. You must select spells that are at least 2 ranks below the rank of this spell and each of the spells you select must be of a different rank. You can choose a higher rank for a spell than its listed rank. The aspect can cast each spell once for the duration of the summon. If you select a cantrip, the cantrip’s spell DC is reduced by 2, but the aspect can cast it at will for the duration.

Quick Capture.name: Quick Capture
Quick Capture.description:
Trigger A creature ends its turn within reach of the aspect

The aspect makes an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the triggering creature.

Heightened (4th) The aspect can use Quick Capture when it succeeds at a Strike with its primary attack. In addition, creatures that end their turn grabbed or restrained by the aspect take damage equal to @Damage[(@actor.flags.pf2e.aspectRank * 2)[@actor.flags.pf2e.damageTypeConCarne]]{twice the rank of the spell}. The damage type is the same as its primary attack would deal.

Legendary Cry.name: Legendary Cry
Legendary Cry.description: The aspect roars out, affecting the hearts of all allies within a @Template[distance:30|type:emanation], granting them temporary Hit Points equal to twice the rank of the spell for 1 minute. Allies also gain a +1 status bonus to melee attack rolls for as long as they have temporary Hit Points.

Gift of Vitality.name: Gift of Vitality
Gift of Vitality.description:
The aspect is an entirely good creature. The aspect can restore @Damage[(max(@actor.flags.pf2e.aspectRank,1))d6[healing]] Hit Points per rank of the spell to an adjacent creature as a single action. The creature is then temporarily immune to this effect for 1 hour.

Heightened (4th) Depending on your sub aspect, you gain additional benefits to its Celestial Gift.

  • Agathion

    • Gift of Vitality The aspect can deal vitality damage to an adjacent creature of the same amount it would normally restore with a @Check[fortitude|dc:@actor.flags.pf2e.aspectDC|basic:true] save.

  • Angel

    • Gift of Vitality The aspect can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} as a spell equal to half the spell’s rank, but if it does the aspect spell ends.

  • Archon

    • Gift of Vitality The aspect can make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy when it uses Archon’s Protection if the enemy is within range.

  • Azata

    • Gift of Vitality The aspect sings and inspires all within range. All allies within 30 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

Effect: Calling Rune.name: Effect: Calling Rune
Effect: Calling Rune.description: The ring’s magic guides your attack. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would summon a creature capable of making Strikes, the summon gains a status bonus to its Strikes equal to your power ring’s item bonus. You cannot use Veracious Spell until the summon spell ends.

Eat Soul.name: Eat Soul
Eat Soul.description:
Trigger The aspect reduces a living creature to 0 Hit Points;

The aspect eats the creature’s soul, causing it to die immediately. It gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws for the duration of the spell.

Effect: Windy Aura.name: Effect: Windy Aura
Effect: Windy Aura.description: Winds whip around the aspect making it hard to approach. Ranged attacks against creatures within the area take a –1 circumstance penalty and the area is difficult terrain to creatures in flight.

Tools of Darkness.name: Tools of Darkness
Tools of Darkness.description:
You form shadows into useful tools. You can form your shadow into a shadow tool, and your shadow disappears for the duration. The shadow tool must be a simple tool, such as a shovel or rope, and it appears in your hands or adjacent to you. The tool lasts until it’s used for a single activity or for 1 minute, whichever comes first, after which it disappears. The tool is obviously temporarily conjured and thus can’t be sold or passed off as a genuine item.

Heightened (4th) You can Cast the Spell as a 2-action activity and you can spend a single action to use the tool as part of your casting. Your tool grants a +1 item bonus to checks made with it.

Heightened (8th) You can Cast the Spell as a single action and you can spend a single action to use the tool as part of your casting. Your tool grants a +2 item bonus to checks made with it.

Innate Sleep.name: Innate Sleep
Innate Sleep.description: The hypnagog aspect can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.o4lRVTwSxnOOn5vl]{Sleep} as an innate spell two ranks below the rank of the spell once per day.

Hunter of Death.name: Hunter of Death
Hunter of Death.description: The aspect Strikes deal 1 additional spirit damage per weapon damage dice against creatures with fewer than half its maximum Hit Points.

Overclock.name: Overclock
Overclock.description:
Requirements A creature wound its key at least once since the aspect’s last turn

The aspect is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for a number of rounds equal to the number of times its key was turned. The aspect can use the extra action each round for only Strike and Stride actions.

Enhanced Aid.name: Enhanced Aid
Enhanced Aid.description:
Enhanced Aid (Battle Form) You gain a +1 status bonus to the listed skill. If the spell you cast was at least 8th-rank, you gain a +2 status bonus to the listed skill and when you get a result of a critical failure with the listed skill, you get a failure instead.

Enhanced Aid (Summon) The aspect can always use the listed skill to Aid. If the spell that summoned the creature was at least 4th rank, it grants a +3 circumstance bonus when it gets a critical success with its check to Aid or a +4 circumstance bonus if the spell was at least 8th rank.

Fringes.name: Fringes
Fringes.description: The aspect lives on the edge of society. It speaks aklo and can Hide without cover as it blends into the background, either with shapeshifting, magic or camouflage.

Water.name: Water
Water.description: This elemental is made of liquid or ice, like a brineshark or icewyrm.

Splinter Wood.name: Splinter Wood
Splinter Wood.description: The wood elemental causes non-magical wooden objects in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] within 30 feet to take @Damage[(@actor.flags.pf2e.aspectRank)d8[piercing]]{1d8 piercing damage per rank} of the spell with a @Check[fortitude|dc:@actor.flags.pf2e.aspectDC|basic:true]. Creatures adjacent to a wooden object that gained the broken condition or was destroyed by this ability also take the damage from the spell.
